scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api --if-present && npm run build -w apps/web --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tor-radar/shared && npm run build -w @tor-radar/seeds
